title: Repository policy
description: A file under policies/ (design v3 §1.2, §6.2). Repository-wide rules about what no task may change, whatever it was asked to do. This is not scope: scope is per-task, and a task that declares none is unrestricted by it.

protected.description: A policy that protects nothing is one nobody will notice is broken.

path.description: A glob against a repository-relative path. `a/**` protects a whole subtree.

reason.description: Why this matters. The operator reads it at the gate, so it should say what would go wrong rather than restate the path. A rule that cannot say why it exists is one nobody can judge.
